The NYC Artist Coalition research run distinguishes the complete 2,192-item governed population from 18 close-read documents, 201 source candidates, a 1,413-item rights queue, and zero selected projections.

Five original NYC Artist Coalition documents were re-opened in their native representation. The resulting pages record what the present encounter confirmed or narrowed without treating access as publication permission or erasing earlier uncertainty.
